name: Comcast Business / Masergy
product_focus: Comcast Business SASE, Masergy AIOps heritage
evidence_summary: Comcast sources evidence SASE combining SD-WAN and security, available fully managed or co-managed; press release evidences managed SD-WAN market position.
cost_model: Quote-based managed/co-managed service; access, SD-WAN, SASE and SOC/AIOps elements drive cost.
key_differentiators: SASE combining SD-WAN and security available fully managed or co-managed, drawing on Masergy AIOps heritage.
Recognised as a leading managed SD-WAN provider by industry analysts.
Strong North American underlay ownership with international delivery via partners.
best_fit_for: North American enterprises wanting managed or co-managed SD-WAN and SASE from a single carrier.
Buyers attracted to the AIOps capabilities inherited from the Masergy acquisition.
Organisations prioritising co-managed delivery with shared operational control.
watch_outs: International delivery depth depends on partnerships outside North America.
Underlying platform choice should be confirmed; service depth varies by selected platform.
Commercial model bundles access, SD-WAN, SASE and SOC elements; explicit line-item costing required.
verification_notes: Re-verified 2026-07-29 against named primary sources. Every graded fact carries a source, a tier and a verbatim quote confirmed present on the cited page by an independent check. Industry, region, organisation-size and pricing evidence was sourced on the same basis. Facts that could not be sourced are published as unknown with the reason. The value_tier field is a Netify assessment of relative cost position, not a supplier claim: most of this market publishes no price. Sources found and rejected are listed at tier 4.

ai_capability.note: Masergy AIOps digital twin for managed customers; predictive fault analytics.

resilience.note: 4G LTE backup widely bundled; Masergy global core adds route diversity.

profile.platform_architecture: Comcast Business pairs the largest US cable access network with the Masergy acquisition's global software-defined platform, delivering managed SD-WAN domestically and internationally. Platform options span VeloCloud and Fortinet alongside Masergy's own service fabric, with 4G LTE backup widely bundled at US sites. The Masergy digital twin AIOps capability monitors estates predictively.
profile.security_sase: Managed SASE builds on Fortinet and partner SSE stacks with Masergy's managed detection and response heritage providing security operations. Depth follows the platform; the AIOps layer and unified global service management are the distinctive contributions.
profile.service_support_channel: Fully managed and co-managed with 24x7 operations. The US access estate gives on-net economics domestically; international delivery rides Masergy's established global footprint with UK presence. Mid-market and enterprise both served well, a Masergy signature.
profile.commercials_verdict: Per-site managed pricing, quote based, often compelling where Comcast access is on-net. The Netify verdict: shortlist Comcast Business for US-weighted estates with international spokes, mid-market multinationals wanting enterprise-grade managed service without incumbent-carrier overhead, and buyers valuing AIOps-driven proactive operations.

vendor_faqs.q: What did Masergy bring to Comcast Business?
vendor_faqs.a: A global managed SD-WAN and security platform with a strong mid-market enterprise reputation, international delivery, and the digital twin AIOps capability for predictive operations: effectively Comcast's enterprise WAN engine beyond the cable footprint.

vendor_faqs.q: How good is the international coverage?
vendor_faqs.a: Masergy's software-defined platform reaches major global markets with UK presence included. The deepest economics remain US on-net; international sites are delivered credibly via the global fabric and partners.
Widely bundled at US sites, giving day-one resilience against access cuts. For UK and international sites, confirm equivalent cellular resilience options during design.

shortlist_summary: Comcast Business bring the Masergy AIOps heritage into a fully managed or co-managed SASE service combining SD-WAN and security, and that operational intelligence tooling is a genuine differentiator rather than a marketing addition. Typically shortlisted by mid-to-large enterprises where AI-driven operations and strong service visibility are weighted criteria alongside the core SASE capability.
cost_note: Per-site managed pricing, often compelling where Comcast access is on-net in the US.
uk_basis: No UK HQ (US). UK delivery via the Masergy global platform and partners.

f01_fully_managed_service.quote: VARs and MSPs to sell fully managed SD-WAN services (provided entirely by Comcast Business) and co-managed services
f01_fully_managed_service.note: Comcast Business states the fully managed variant is provided entirely by itself. The Masergy product sheet reinforces this with "all as a globally-available managed service". Underlying SD-WAN and firewall technology is Fortinet's, but the operating model is Comcast Business end to end.

f03_co_managed_service.quote: Managed or co-managed service from a single provider with optional 24/7 monitoring and management
f03_co_managed_service.note: Co-managed is explicitly offered alongside fully managed on the SD-WAN product page and in the 2023 Masergy Guardian press release. The split of retained customer change rights is not itemised on the pages reviewed.

f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.quote: The Masergy Guardian Portfolio™ supports the reseller community with a combined offering that uniquely converges networking, security, and services
f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.note: Evidence supports a reseller/VAR/MSP sales route only. No page reviewed evidences tenant isolation, delegated administration, branded partner portals or templates, which the definition requires for a full yes. Graded partial on the reseller-programme evidence alone.

f05_professional_services_and_migration_.note: The SD-WAN page lists "Network configuration with solution architects", "Installation validation" and "Network consultation and access to SD-WAN experts (post installation)", which covers design and implementation. No evidence found of documented migration runbooks, rollback plans, pilots or training programmes, so graded partial rather than yes.

f07_lifecycle_management.note: Hardware replacement is contractually covered as part of the managed service. No statement found on the pages reviewed covering firmware upgrades, patching, renewals or end-of-life planning, so graded partial. CPE is Fortinet hardware per the Masergy product sheet.

f17_cellular_and_5g_support.quote: Help keep your network running with 4G LTE backup.
f17_cellular_and_5g_support.note: 4G LTE is documented as a backup transport. No evidence found on the pages reviewed for 5G, for cellular as a primary transport, or for SIM management and signal monitoring, so graded partial.

f19_public_cloud_gateways.quote: Comcast Business Secure Gateways are hosted across the United States at Equinix data centers, offering up to 10 gigabits per second (Gbps) of cloud connectivity for public, private, or hybrid cloud deployments.
f19_public_cloud_gateways.note: Comcast Business brands and operates the Secure Gateways, but the enforcement stack is Fortinet technology and the hosting fabric is Equinix, per the same release: "Fortinet's security-driven networking technology and Equinix's flexible cloud connection Equinix Fabric™ for a complete secure network service." Under the definition this is partner_integrated, not yes. Footprint stated as United States only.

f20_private_pops_dedicated_pops.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. Checked the SASE page, the Fortinet SASE/SSE press releases and the Masergy global gateway page. Secure Gateways are described as shared infrastructure hosted at Equinix; no offer of customer-hosted, dedicated or sovereign PoPs was found.

f21_private_global_backbone.quote: Our high-speed, high-capacity internet operates across our vast and growing hybrid fiber-coax network, with more than 350,000 miles of fiber.
f21_private_global_backbone.note: The owned network described is national, not global: "Our vast and growing footprint spans 29 regional networks in 39 states". Masergy reach is described commercially as "serving more than 1,400 customers in nearly 100 countries" but no page reviewed states that inter-region traffic rides a Comcast-owned or Comcast-controlled global backbone. Per the definition, a single-country network is graded partial.

f26_sla_backed_service_fabric.quote: Our service level agreements (SLAs) are trailblazing in the industry, with 100% uptime for all high availability-configured Masergy SD-WAN Secure sites, 100% cloud service reachability for AWS, Azure, and 200+ providers, along with an industry-leading 5-minute proactive outage notification.
f26_sla_backed_service_fabric.note: Contractual commitments cover uptime, cloud reachability, outage notification, equipment replacement (24x7x4 on-net) and change handling ("MAC SLOs (simple/complex) — 30 minutes/12 hours"), with service credits stated in the product sheet.

f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.note: The firewall and NGFW functions are Fortinet technology that Comcast Business bundles and manages. The 2022 release lists "Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), Intrusion Prevention (IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)." delivered on Fortinet's stack. Cisco SD-WAN is also resold. Graded partner_integrated per the definition.

f33_data_loss_prevention.quote: Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), Intrusion Prevention (IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).
f33_data_loss_prevention.note: DLP is named as part of the SASE/SSE offer but is delivered on Fortinet's security-driven networking technology, so partner_integrated rather than yes. No detail found on classification depth, blocking versus flagging, alerting or exception workflows.

f40_managed_service_assurance.quote: Get 24/7 customer support with experts at security operations centers (SOCs).
f40_managed_service_assurance.note: 24/7 SOC support and "Proactive monitoring, ticket creation, and remediation" are documented. No page reviewed evidences ownership of incidents through to root cause analysis, structured service reviews or formal change governance, so graded partial rather than yes.

delivery_model.quote: VARs and MSPs to sell fully managed SD-WAN services (provided entirely by Comcast Business) and co-managed services
delivery_model.note: Comcast Business operates a network and a managed service wrapper; the SD-WAN and security technology it delivers is Fortinet's (and Cisco's in other variants), and the SASE/SSE gateway fabric is Equinix. It is not authoring the SD-WAN or SSE product itself on the evidence reviewed, so managed_provider rather than both.

underlay_ownership.quote: Our high-speed, high-capacity internet operates across our vast and growing hybrid fiber-coax network, with more than 350,000 miles of fiber.
underlay_ownership.note: Comcast Business owns extensive last-mile and metro fibre in the United States and describes itself as "the largest facilities-based, last-mile alternative to the phone company in the U.S." Outside that footprint it clearly rides third-party access, evidenced by the on-net versus off-net distinction in its own SLA table ("Equipment replacement SLA — 24x7x4 (On-Net) and 8X5XNBD (Off-Net)"), and customer-provided underlays are supported. Hence mixed rather than owns_own_circuits.

sse_layer_ownership.quote: Fortinet's security-driven networking technology and Equinix's flexible cloud connection Equinix Fabric™ for a complete secure network service.
sse_layer_ownership.note: Fortinet. The SASE and SSE stack (FWaaS, IPS, DLP, CASB, ZTNA) is Fortinet technology delivered through Comcast Business Secure Gateways hosted in Equinix data centres; Equinix supplies the interconnection fabric. The Masergy SD-WAN Secure product sheet separately confirms the edge is "Powered by industry-leading Fortinet® hardware". Cisco is a further third-party SD-WAN option in the wider portfolio.

regulatory_documentation.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. Checked the cybersecurity services page, the SASE page and both SD-WAN product pages. No NHS DSPT, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS or HIPAA attestation was named on any page fetched, and no trust centre page was located. Targeted searches for a Comcast Business compliance or trust page returned no supplier-hosted result.

pop_count.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The 2022 SASE/SSE release says Secure Gateways are "hosted across the United States at Equinix data centers" but publishes no count. The Masergy global gateway page is now a redirect stub. The Our Network page publishes fibre miles and "29 regional networks in 39 states" but no PoP figure.

sla_availability_pct.quote: Our service level agreements (SLAs) are trailblazing in the industry, with 100% uptime for all high availability-configured Masergy SD-WAN Secure sites, 100% cloud service reachability for AWS, Azure, and 200+ providers, along with an industry-leading 5-minute proactive outage notification.
sla_availability_pct.note: The 100% figure is conditional: it applies only to high availability-configured Masergy SD-WAN Secure sites, not to all sites. A different figure, 99.99%, appears on the SASE page for dedicated connectivity solutions. Conflict recorded; not resolved.

sectors.healthcare.quote: Help protect patients and your network with advanced security solutions that provide key SASE capabilities.
sectors.healthcare.note: Dedicated healthcare industry page that ties SASE capability directly to the sector, which meets the dedicated industry page test. The healthcare page itself carries no named customer, but the enterprise landing page displays HCA Healthcare and Brigham and Women's Hospital among its customer logos and case studies. Graded on the dedicated page, not on the logos.

sectors.financial_services.quote: STAR Financial Bank powers new technology
sectors.financial_services.note: Dedicated financial services page with a named bank case study, a named CIO quote from Philadelphia Federal Credit Union and a US Bank feature. Three named customers in the sector.

sectors.retail_ecommerce.quote: Digital resilience: Inside the tech transformation at Burger King
sectors.retail_ecommerce.note: Dedicated retail page with named case studies for Burger King, Denny's and Jack in the Box plus an American Furniture Rental testimonial. Note the retail evidence skews heavily to multi-site restaurant and physical store estates rather than pure ecommerce; no ecommerce-specific customer was found.

sectors.manufacturing.quote: Manufacturers of any finished good need a fast and reliable network to ensure that their facilities can maintain daily production flows.
sectors.manufacturing.note: Dedicated manufacturing industry page, which meets the test. The supporting case study is anonymised as a Houston-based manufacturer rather than a named customer, so this is weaker evidence than the retail or financial services grades.

sectors.energy_utilities.note: Checked the industry solutions hub twice; the published list is Federal Government, State and Local Government, Education, Financial Services, Healthcare, Hospitality, Restaurants and Food Services, Manufacturing, Retail, Property Development and Sports and Entertainment. Energy and utilities is not among them, and no energy or utility customer, case study or page was found on the enterprise landing page or the SD-WAN pages. No inference drawn from general enterprise capability.

sectors.government_public_sector.quote: Comcast Business Communications, LLC dba Comcast Business is the GSA-approved contract holder.
sectors.government_public_sector.note: Strongest sector evidence in the set: a published GSA MAS IT contract number (GS-35F-184BA), plus a federal government page naming GSA Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS) and DISA Commercial Ethernet Gateway (CEG), and a separate state and local government page in the industry list. All evidence is US public sector; nothing found for UK, EU or other national public sectors.

sectors.education.quote: Enhancing connectivity at University of Virginia with Private Wireless Network solution
sectors.education.note: Dedicated education page with a named institution case study. The named deployment is a private wireless network rather than SD-WAN or SASE specifically, so the sector presence is proven but the SASE relevance is indirect.

sectors.transport_logistics.note: Not present in the eleven published industry solutions. Checked the industry hub, the enterprise landing page customer logos and the SD-WAN product pages; no transport, fleet, logistics or distribution customer or case study found.

sectors.professional_services.note: Not present in the eleven published industry solutions. The enterprise landing page displays a Morningstar logo, which is a financial data and research firm, but there is no professional services industry page, no professional services framing and no case study read in this task that positions it as a served sector. Graded unknown rather than partial because a single logo without sector framing is not a sector claim.

sectors.hospitality_leisure.quote: How Choice Hotels International expanded internet access and improved guest satisfaction
sectors.hospitality_leisure.note: Dedicated hospitality page with a named case study and a named customer quote from Choice Hotels International, plus Best Western Hotels (BWH), Citizen M and White Elephant. The separate Restaurants and Food Services and Sports and Entertainment pages reinforce leisure coverage.

regions.uk_ireland.quote: Comcast's significant access network in the U.S., and to a less extent the U.K., form the ideal partner for Masergy's global SDN network,
regions.uk_ireland.note: The UK is the only non-US access geography named in anything read in this task, and it is named by a dated named-author trade article quoting an analyst, not by a Comcast coverage page. No UK point of presence list, no UK service availability page and nothing at all for Ireland. Graded partial, not yes, because no supplier coverage publication was found.

regions.europe.quote: Masergy has become a leading provider to companies worldwide – serving more than 1,400 customers in nearly 100 countries.
regions.europe.note: The vendor publishes a nearly 100 countries service claim (restated in the 2023 partner deck as over 100 countries) but publishes no region breakdown, no European point of presence list and no per-country availability page. The one document titled as a country list, the Masergy countries product sheet, is behind a login and returned no country names. Graded partial on a non-region-specific delivery claim; upgrade only if the country sheet is obtained.

regions.north_america.note: US delivery is unambiguous: nationwide coverage, 185k fibre route miles, over 1.8 million Ethernet-enabled buildings and 700+ connected data centres in the partner deck, and the SD-WAN pages frame the base case as a single U.S. location. Ranked number one US provider for Managed SD-WAN by Vertical Systems Group 2024 per the SD-WAN page. Caveat: all the specific evidence is United States; nothing Canada-specific or Mexico-specific was found.

regions.asia_pacific.quote: Masergy has become a leading provider to companies worldwide – serving more than 1,400 customers in nearly 100 countries.
regions.asia_pacific.note: Same basis as Europe. No Asia Pacific point of presence, country list or in-region delivery page found across the SD-WAN, secure networking, Masergy transition and partner deck sources. The gated countries product sheet blocked confirmation.

regions.middle_east_africa.quote: Masergy has become a leading provider to companies worldwide – serving more than 1,400 customers in nearly 100 countries.
regions.middle_east_africa.note: Same basis as Europe and Asia Pacific. No Middle East or Africa point of presence, customer, office or coverage statement found in any page read. This is the weakest of the partial grades and rests entirely on an aggregate country count.

regions.latin_america.quote: Masergy has become a leading provider to companies worldwide – serving more than 1,400 customers in nearly 100 countries.
regions.latin_america.note: Same basis as the other non-US regions. No Latin America specific coverage, point of presence or customer evidence found. Note also the TBRI analyst commentary (source 21) characterises the international base as US-headquartered customers served in their non-US locations rather than in-region acquisition, which cuts against reading the country count as independent regional presence.

regions.china_mainland.note: Treated the nearly 100 countries claim as evidence of nothing here, per the standing rule that mainland China requires a specific licensed arrangement. No ICP licence, no named Chinese carrier partner, no China point of presence and no China service page were found. The Masergy countries product sheet that might have listed China is gated behind a login.

organisation_fit.large_global_enterprise.quote: The acquisition accelerates Comcast Business's increasing growth serving large and mid-size companies, particularly U.S.-based organizations with multi-site global operations.
organisation_fit.large_global_enterprise.note: Explicit vendor targeting statement, reinforced by the enterprise page claim of serving over 90% of the Fortune 500 and by dated trade coverage describing the Masergy deal as an upscale move toward the Fortune 500 and Global 2000. Worth flagging for buyers that the vendor's own framing is US-headquartered organisations with global sites, not natively global enterprises.

organisation_fit.mid_market.quote: The acquisition accelerates Comcast Business's increasing growth serving large and mid-size companies, particularly U.S.-based organizations with multi-site global operations.
organisation_fit.mid_market.note: Mid-size is named alongside large in the vendor's own targeting statement, and the 2023 press release adds a distinct SD-WAN product tier for small and medium businesses with single or standalone locations, which is a product tier aimed at this band.

organisation_fit.small_business.quote: Comcast Business provides business capabilities at affordable prices for small businesses.
organisation_fit.small_business.note: Strong on all four tests: a dedicated small business storefront, published monthly list pricing, an explicit affordability positioning sentence, a purpose-built SD-WAN tier for small and medium businesses announced in 2023, and the claim of serving millions of small businesses. Comcast Business is unusual in this comparison set in genuinely covering all three size bands.

published_pricing.quote: Comcast Business provides business capabilities at affordable prices for small businesses.
published_pricing.note: No price is published for the SD-WAN or SASE service anywhere read. The SD-WAN detail page discloses only the charging model, a single rate per site, plus generic competitive pricing language. The only actual figures published on the site are small business internet access plans, with entry points around $60 to $70 per month rising to $180 per month for 2 Gigabit, and Comcast Business Mobile from $24 per month per line. Graded value on that published access pricing plus the explicit affordability positioning, and held at low confidence because those figures cover access, not the managed SD-WAN or SASE product a buyer would actually be comparing. Treat as unknown for SASE-specific budgeting.

conflicts.claim_a: 100% uptime for all high availability-configured Masergy SD-WAN Secure sites
Masergy SD-WAN Secure product sheet states the service is "Powered by industry-leading Fortinet® hardware"
conflicts.claim_b: Comcast Business also markets a managed SD-WAN built on Cisco technology, indicating more than one third-party underlying stack
